cliConventions.profileRule: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen only
cliConventions.stderr: single error envelope JSON object on failure

exitCodeSemantics.13: environment or release compatibility blocked; upgrade CLI per error.clientUpgrade.upgradeUrl
exitCodeSemantics.20: operation recoverable, not converged in this run; continue with operationRef

identifiers.projectId: lowercase UUID; persisted across processes; required for cross-process retry
identifiers.submitId: lowercase UUID; never empty on recovery; CLI freezes one per process; empty string rejected with exit 2
identifiers.nodeId: lowercase UUID; returned by node APIs; use node find to look up
identifiers.updateId: lowercase UUID; returned by node edit; the retry identity for node edits
identifiers.operationRef: alias for submitId in operation status/wait
identifiers.resourceId: lowercase canonical UUID only (no urn:uuid:, no hyphen-stripped, no resource_ prefix)
identifiers.quoteId: lowercase UUID; binds approval to the latest authoritative draft
identifiers.creditConfirmationToken: short-lived, in-memory only; never persisted, logged, or journaled

referenceSyntax.nodeRef: node:node_xxx — refers to a node's latest resource and creates a canvas edge
referenceSyntax.resourceRef: res:<lowercase UUID> — frozen to a specific resource, no canvas edge
referenceSyntax.promptPlaceholder: {{type:value}} — inline placeholders that become references when mentioned in prompt
referenceSyntax.elementSlots: main/voice/auxiliary/description take bare node_xxx or lowercase UUID; node: prefix returns cli.invalid_resource_reference exit 2

invariant: Saving a node is not generation; paid commands require quote-bound action-time approval; reusing submitId never re-bills; switching submitId re-bills.
